method: Static browser contact sheets for all four life stages; colour variants share byte-identical alpha masks and were also inspected in the palette gallery. Technical checks are separate from visual approval. In-game spot check of wheel mounts. This does not approve every animation or every three-piece combination.

groups.finding: New generated intermediate collection: visible but disabled for every species. Explorer contact sheet shows undersized crown anchors; individual fitting and motion approval remain required before unlocking. Comet is an inventory toy preview, not a wearable.
Head accessories need individual contact/occlusion at horns, antennae and rotors. Similar anchors alone do not prove contact.
Cap reads as a flat miniature; crown/head intersections require refinement. No global artistic approval.
Lowered below mouth, but source is a flat striped strip: needs neck wrap and folds.
Generic skirt does not form a fitted bodice or respect arms/paws and torso depth.
Corrected boat and pig newborn height. Some angles still need frame/temple contact and a clear choice of eyes versus forehead.
Handbag has a handle but no body-following shoulder strap or grip; floats beside the body.
Fixed pair has the same spacing and sole-forward orientation for every anatomy; individual paws need separate fits/occlusion.
Handle does not meet the paw/hand in multiple poses; needs grip landmarks and foreground paw layers.
Reduced size and moved below face; checked all compatible stages. Ribbon wrap and moving poses still need approval.
Saddle reads as a small shoulder ornament rather than resting on the back; perspective and straps need revision.
Audit now draws wings behind the body like gameplay. Attachment, wing joints and flight animation remain unapproved.
Source artwork reads as floating badge/bottle; needs a physical mount or explicit ground prop presentation.
Vehicle source already contains a spoiler; generic overlay duplicates stock part instead of replacing it. Removed from robot anatomy.
Static roof placement inspected; rotor/chimney clearance during movement still requires validation.
Side overlay needs chassis contact, rear placement and attachment hardware; removed from robot anatomy.
Individual perspective-scaled hubs for both car and tractor, all stages; removed wheel over robot torso. Verified in gameplay.
Integrated clothes and bag strap are coherent. Same dressed character is scaled through growth; distinct age-specific dressed anatomy still missing.
Transparent rendered toy already used in gameplay. Interaction with every species remains a separate motion review.
Still platform-dependent emoji; inconsistent with the rendered art direction.

source_issues.finding: Adult base cutout regenerated without magenta. Newborn, child and several care poses still contain magenta pixels and require cleanup.
Butterfly source images include NINI lettering/marks, visible during every accessory inspection. Requires clean source sprites.
Separate accessories are hidden on uncalibrated action/sleep poses. This avoids wrong overlays but means outfit continuity is not complete.
